scope: Theoretical 5 N transverse-compliance bench screening of the exact single current RadialArm; not a joint, the drone, or a physical experiment.
evidenceBoundary: Approved Brief r4 RadialArm assumptions and radial-arm-bench-displacement criterion. The server must recross the unique current canonical part geometry, its engineering provenance and the native SysON requirement; none is declared by this source. Ideal fully clamped root end face at x = -50 mm; total force (0, 0, -5) N on the tip end face at x = 50 mm. Material is a theoretical EN AW-6082-T6 catalogue isotropic idealization with E = 70000 MPa and nu = 0.33, not an as-built claim. One 1 mm target mesh is not convergence evidence. Excludes joints, bolts, preload, contact, self-weight, motor torque, dynamic thrust, vibration, fatigue, buckling, impact, geometric or material nonlinearity, tolerances, factor of safety, manufacture, whole-drone behaviour, flight and certification. A pass does not resolve the motor interface or establish flight readiness. Revision 3 requests a fresh seal and isolated run on the server-selected current Thread after architecture r98 and RadialArm recapture r100, so L4 can join the current requirement projection. Target, material, mesh, supports, loads, units and criterion remain identical to revision 2; no historical result is promoted or copied. This does not encode scenario-A airspeed, HOLD motor power, or flight.

material.basis: Theoretical EN AW-6082-T6 catalogue model from the official Hydro data sheet, read 2026-09-08: E 70000 MPa, nu 0.33. No selected product form, stock, heat-treatment preservation or batch certificate.
